items.title: Lumentum Holdings (LITE) Could Be 90% Undervalued Following The Marvell Deal
items.summary: Why Lumentum’s stock is suddenly tied to Marvell Lumentum Holdings (LITE) is back in focus after Marvell Technology agreed to buy the photonics group in an all stock deal that values Lumentum at roughly US$115b, with shareholders receiving 4.5 Marvell shares for each Lumentum share. Lumentum Holdings has swung sharply lower in the short term, with the share price down about 54% over 30 days and 43% over 90 days. items.title: Coherent Surges 13% as Investors Revisit $20 Billion AI Deal After Sell-Off; Lumentum Climbs 4%, Applied Optoelectronics Gains 3%

items.title: The US adds in the latest  jobs report, markets try to bounce back from an awful sell-off
items.summary:
Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on the US adding 165K jobs in the October Jobs Report, the bumpy road ahead for Tesla (TSLA) and the electric vehicle market, and what Democratic control means for the markets and trade.

Today's panel includes POLITICO Economics Correspondent and Columnist Victoria Guida, RSM Chief Economist Joe Brusuelas, FBB Capital Partners President Mike Mussio, and Kelly Intelligence Founder, CEO, and CCO Kevin Kelly.

items.title: Coherent Soars 13% as Citi Lifts Target to $440, Lumentum Up 3% in AI Optics Rebound
